context_notes: macOS CI failed because spu94_q15.h used _Static_assert (C11) but tests/api/c99_consumer.c compiles with -std=c99 -Werror. Fix: added C99 fallback using negative-array-size trick in SPU94_STATIC_ASSERT macro. Windows CI failed because both spu94_shared and spu94_static set OUTPUT_NAME to 'spu94', producing colliding .lib files. Fix: static lib renamed to spu94_static on WIN32. Linux build was already created as a tarball on Desktop (SPU-94-v1.7-beta.1-linux.tar.gz).
